title: Pay yourself a reasonable salary
summary: S-corp owners must take a reasonable W-2 salary before distributions. Other entities follow your draw schedule.
detailsHtml:
Determining "reasonable"

The IRS examines what you'd pay a non-owner to perform your specific functions, using industry benchmarks. Resources: RC Reports, Bureau of Labor Statistics OEWS data, Salary.com. Document your reasoning each year — auditors look for documentation as much as for the number itself.

Salary vs. distribution optimization

Higher salary increases SE/payroll tax but also increases retirement contribution limits (for plans tied to W-2 wages) and Social Security benefits. Lower salary saves SE tax but limits retirement contributions. Most planners target a salary high enough to fund retirement contributions and qualify for safe-harbor 401(k) plans, with the balance as distributions.
